prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” interior painter for all homeowners in St. Louis — the right company depends on your home, budget, schedule, and the level of prep/finish you want. I can help you find the best fit. Here’s a fast, practical way to get to a top-quality painter and what to look for.

How to find the best interior painting company near you
- Get at least 3 written estimates from different companies. Compare scope, prep, materials, timeline, and warranty — not just price.
- Use local review sites: Google Reviews, Yelp, Angi (Angie’s List), Houzz, BBB, and Nextdoor for neighborhood recommendations.
- Ask friends/neighbors for recent referrals and photos of finished work.

Must-check credentials and quality signals
- Insurance and liability coverage (ask for COI).
- Proof of business license (if required) and local references with phone numbers.
- Portfolio of recent interior jobs (photos) and client testimonials.
- Lead-safe/RRP certification if your house was built before 1978.
- Written contract with scope, paint brand/finish, start & completion dates, payment schedule, cleanup policy, and warranty.

Questions to ask every painter
- How many coats and what brand/line of paint will you use?
- Will you move or protect furniture and flooring? How do you handle trim, ceilings, doors?
- Do you do drywall repair, texture match, and caulking? Is that included in the estimate?
- Who will be on site (employees vs. subs)? Will they run background checks?
- What is your timeline and how do you manage delays?
- Can you provide references from customers with similar projects?

Typical cost guidance (approximate)
- Most interior projects are bid per room or per square foot; prices vary widely by condition and finish.
- Ballpark: $200–$800+ per average-sized room depending on prep and paint quality; $1.50–$4.00+ per sq. ft. of painted surface for larger jobs. (Get local quotes for accurate pricing.)

Red flags
- Very low bids with vague scope.
- No written contract or insurance proof.
- Pressure to pay large up-front sums in cash.

Want me to help more specifically?
- Tell me your zip code, type/size of project (one room, whole house, trim only), and any special needs (wallpaper removal, high ceilings, lead risk). I’ll give a tailored shortlist of how to find top-rated painters in your area, a message template to request quotes, and a comparison checklist.
